hero.tagline: I build and run backend services, integrations and business apps with Python, React and Angular. Currently shipping production systems at Pyansa.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full-Stack developer focused on Python. At Pyansa I work on an integration service that connects 6+ ERPs and internal systems, an electronic invoicing system (CFDI 4.0) and the backend of a warehouse management system.
about.p2: I came to software from manufacturing engineering and QA, so I care about things that keep a system dependable: tests, clear contracts, repeatable deployments and documented decisions.
about.p3: I work spec-first (OpenSpec): I define each change and its acceptance criteria before coding, and keep the decisions documented. I use AI as part of the workflow and review every change before it ships.

bullets: Integration service in FastAPI + Celery with connectors to 6+ ERPs and internal systems unified into one model, consumed by the internal apps.

Designed and built a CFDI 4.0 electronic invoicing system (Mexican tax compliance): swappable PAC drivers, payment complements, automatic accounting; test suite grown from 1,500 to 3,000 tests in three weeks.
Warehouse management system: Django / DRF backend and Angular 19 front end, including the inventory audit cycle from scanner count to ERP adjustment.
Corporate single sign-on with Keycloak (OIDC) and scoped roles.
Three production cutovers (SSO, data platform, WMS) in four days, with rehearsal, rollback plan and backups, and no data loss.
Modernized two legacy PHP 5.6 applications to PHP 8.3+ without stopping operations.
Deployed on GCP with Docker and GitLab CI/CD; automated tests with pytest.
Manual functional testing, bug reporting in Jira, traffic inspection with Fiddler and Charles, work in Scrum teams.
Project engineer, innovation, molding and quality system coordinator roles; led the ISO 9001:2015 certification and the ABS foundry approval.
Supervised the molding team and introduced a new molding method that raised quality and production capacity.
Built a quoting system (React, Flask, MySQL) and KPI dashboards (Python, SQL) for the plant.
